name: Pell Asante
title: Ensign
note: The youngest officer on the bridge, and the best pilot left in the fleet.
appearance: Young, freckled and permanently short of sleep, in a uniform cut for someone taller.
personality: Earnest, brave and quietly terrified. She thinks of you as someone who knows what they're doing, and that's hard to live up to.
voice: Talks too fast, then catches herself and adds "sir" or "Captain" a beat too late.
goals: Prove she belongs on the bridge, and get her little brother onto a safer ship.
secrets: She never finished flight school. She forged her certification during the evacuation of Aurelis because no one else could fly the ship.
